The Subtask Name: Identify the base location for the 514th Flight Test Squadron

The Subtask Name: Identify the namesake of Hill Air Force Base
Step Range: 3-10
The Oracle: Major Ployer Peter Hill
Evidence: Multiple searches confirm Hill AFB is named after Major Ployer "Pete" Hill, a pioneer aviator who died in 1935.

The Subtask Name: Identify the aircraft Major Hill was test-flying
Step Range: 11-21
The Oracle: B-17 Flying Fortress prototype (Model 299/NX13372)
Evidence: Repeated searches indicate Major Hill died while test-flying the B-17 prototype NX13372 (Model 299), which is the aircraft associated with the base's naming.
